title: USA at the World Cup
description: From the Miracle on Grass to 2026 co-hosts — how much do you know about the US Men's National Team at the World Cup?

questions.q: The USA famously beat England 1–0 at the 1950 World Cup. Who scored that iconic goal?
questions.explain: Joe Gaetjens scored with a header in the 37th minute, creating one of the biggest upsets in World Cup history — dubbed the 'Miracle on Grass'.

questions.q: What is the USA's best World Cup result?
questions.explain: The USA reached the semi-finals at the inaugural 1930 World Cup in Uruguay, losing to Argentina 6–1.

questions.q: The USA hosted a memorable World Cup that introduced football to millions. In which year?
questions.explain: The 1994 World Cup in the USA set attendance records that stood for decades. Brazil won the tournament, beating Italy on penalties in the final.

questions.q: Landon Donovan's 91st-minute goal against Algeria in 2010 kept the USA alive. What did it mean?
options: It sent the USA to the semis
questions.explain: Donovan's last-gasp goal gave the USA a 1–0 win, enough to top Group C ahead of England on goal difference.

questions.q: Which team did the USA famously beat 3–2 in the 2002 World Cup group stage?
questions.explain: The USA stunned heavily favoured Portugal 3–2, with goals from McBride, Mathis and Donovan in a landmark American win.

questions.q: The USA was knocked out of the 2014 World Cup in the round of 16 in extra time. Which team did it?
questions.explain: Belgium beat the USA 2–1 in extra time. Goalkeeper Tim Howard set a World Cup record with 16 saves in that match.

questions.q: Who is the USA's all-time top scorer at World Cups?
questions.explain: Landon Donovan scored 5 World Cup goals — 2 in 2002 and 3 in 2010 — making him the USA's all-time leading scorer at the tournament.

questions.q: The USA shockingly failed to qualify for which World Cup?
questions.explain: The USA lost to Trinidad & Tobago in their final qualifier in 2017, missing out on the 2018 World Cup and ending an unbroken run of appearances.

questions.q: Which goalkeeper set a World Cup record with 16 saves in a single match against Belgium in 2014?
questions.explain: Tim Howard's heroic performance against Belgium became iconic — despite the loss, his save tally remains the most in a single World Cup match.

questions.q: The 2026 World Cup final is scheduled to be held in which venue?
questions.explain: MetLife Stadium in East Rutherford, New Jersey (the New York/New Jersey area) is set to host the 2026 World Cup final.
